Fortress 2.5Ltr Mid Oak Anti Slip Decking Stain is a water-based outdoor wood treatment specifically formulated for timber decking. This robust decking stain offers effective protection and enhances timber appearance. Ideal for revitalising existing outdoor decking areas, it provides a durable finish that withstands varied British weather conditions, including rain and sun. The quick-drying, water and UV-resistant formula nourishes the wood and helps prevent timber degradation. Its anti-slip properties contribute to safer outdoor spaces. Coverage is approximately 10 m²/Ltr, making this 2.5Ltr tub an efficient choice for many professional decking projects.
